children: Limbach Holdings acquired Madison-based MEP contractor 1901 for $63.0 million, expanding Midwest scale and capabilities.
Closed acquisition of 1901 for $63.0 million, funded with cash and borrowings under expanded revolving credit facility.
Transaction includes performance-based earnouts up to $6.0 million payable over two years upon meeting targets.
1901 adds ~450 employees (350+ field pros) and establishes Limbach’s largest electrical operation to date.
Company expects 1901 to contribute approximately $140 million in revenue and $11 million in adjusted EBITDA for 2027.
Strategic intent: integrate 1901 while preserving local relationships and apply Limbach’s playbook to deepen engagement and improve margins.
